## Testing checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally (lint, format, types, unit tests, build)
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has unit and/or Playwright coverage
- [ ] Playwright suite passes locally (`npm run test:e2e`) or the failure is explained below
- [ ] No `test.only`, `test.skip`, `test.fixme` or `waitForTimeout` added
- [ ] Any change to selectors/accessible names is reflected in `docs/CONTRACTS.md`
- [ ] The **CI Gate** check is green
